name: Kindred

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Root: Köklenen şampiyonlar hareket edemez ama saldırabilir, bloklayabilir ve kaçabilir; özel saldırı Root'u kaldırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Özel saldırıdan toparlanırken hızlı vur — istila yüklerini 8sn duraklatır. 50 yükte kabus dalgası aktive olur (yakınken degeneration verir). Spider-Verse şampiyonları yükleri daha uzun duraklatır. %5 canda ölümsüz olur ve köklendirir — bunu kapatmak için özel saldırı kullan. Degeneration dirençli veya temassız vuruşlu şampiyonlar en iyi cevap.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mystic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Nightmare's Resurrection
Up to +[29 - 80]% Degeneration Potency based on Missing Health.
Once per fight at 5% Health, inflict a Root Passive for [1.5 - 6] seconds. If triggered during an Opponent's Special Attack, this Root triggers when that Special Attack ends. Kindred is prevented from being knocked out while this Root Passive is active or attempting to activate.
Upon activating this ability, activate Dread Aura at no Power cost. If at or above 30 Infestation Charges, inflict Nightmare Outbreak.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• İyileşme Engeli Bağışıklığı 💚🚫

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Kindred is a being forged in the flames of hell and feels nothing but contempt. They are Immune to Poison, Incinerate, Heal Block, Infuriate, and Intimidate effects.
Centipede Strikes inflict an Atrophy Passive reducing the duration of any new Buffs by 30% for 8 seconds. Max stacks: 3.

abilitySections.title: Infestation Charges - Max Stacks: 50
content: The Opponent is inflicted with an Infestation Charge every 2.5 seconds.
Inflict 1 Infestation Charge when a Buff expires off the Opponent or they make contact with Kindred.
As a Defender, when Kindred is struck by Special Attacks while attacking, inflict 10 Charges.
If Kindred is struck while recovering from a Special Attack, Infestation Charges pause for 8 seconds and cannot be inflicted. 14 seconds against #Spider-Verse Heroes.

abilitySections.title: Nightmare Outbreak - At 50 Infestation Charges
content: Inflict Nightmare Outbreak for 18 seconds.

Nearby Opponents are inflicted with a Degeneration Passive every 0.55 seconds, each dealing [847.71] Direct Damage per second, scaling with Base Attack only. Max stacks: 5. Once the opponent is out of range, they lose 1 Degeneration Passive every 0.2 seconds.
While Kindred's personal Degeneration effects are on the Opponent, Kindred Regenerates 0.75% of missing health every 0.5 seconds.

Inflicting 5 or more Infestation Charges at once by landing Special Attacks inflicts instant Degenerations, dealing a burst of [3,989.2] Direct Damage per Passive Degeneration on the Opponent and pauses Nightmare Outbreak for 2 seconds.
If Kindred is struck by a Heavy Attack, Nightmare Outbreak expires 70% faster. All Infestation Charges are consumed when Nightmare Outbreak expires.

abilitySections.title: Dread Aura
content: Charging a Heavy Attack consumes 30% of a Bar of Power to activate Dread Aura for 6 seconds. Kindred fights more aggressively while Dread Aura is active. Dread Aura is not affected by Ability Accuracy.
As a Defender, every 25% of Max Health Kindred loses, Dread Aura triggers at no Power cost to Kindred.
Kindred gains Stun Immunity.
Infestation Charges are inflicted every 0.75 seconds and the amount of Charges inflicted is doubled.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final hit inflicts 5 Infestation Charges. This can trigger through Block.
The final hit inflicts a Degeneration Debuff dealing [7,978.4] Direct Damage over 14 seconds.
Nightmare Outbreak: While this Debuff is active, Passive Degenerations are prevented from falling off.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first and final hits inflict 5 Infestation Charges.
Dread Aura: During this Attack, Power Steal 6% of a Bar of Power per second. Gain 150% of the Power Stolen.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack gains [14,959.5] Attack Rating.
If the Opponent suffers from Nightmare Outbreak this attack gains an additional [17,452.75] Attack Rating.
